source.sqlReaderQuery:
select TABLE_NAME, TABLE_SCHEMA
from INFORMATION_SCHEMA.TABLES 
where TABLE_NAME like 'Production%' 
and TABLE_TYPE = 'BASE TABLE';
select Count(*) from dbo.drs_sales where cast(LoadDate as date) = cast(getdate() as date);
select * from dbo.drs_sales where cast(LoadDate as date) = cast(getdate() as date);
